basic_details.job_title: Gujarat University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Research Fellow, Office Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat University's Indian Institute of Sustainability (IIS), Ahmedabad, has 3 posts for its Integrated M.B.A. Programme: 1 Research Fellow at Rs. 40,000 per month and 2 Office Assistants at Rs. 18,000 per month. Both salaries are consolidated, and the appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a period of 6 months. The Research Fellow needs a Master's or equivalent degree with 55% marks (or a CGPA of 5.5 out of 10) and 2 years of experience. The Office Assistant needs to be a graduate from a recognized university. Applications go online by email to [email protected] from 27 October 202

how_to_apply: Applicants must submit the online application form according to their preference of position. For the Non-Teaching Post, send applications by email to [email protected]. Applications are accepted from 27 October 2026 until 5:00 PM on 5 November 2026. More details are on the Gujarat University career page.

The "Brief bio-data of candidate" form (Non-Teaching), printed with the notice. It asks for: the post applied for and your area of interest (subject); a photo; your full name, gender, date of birth and category (OPEN / SC / ST / SEBC / PH); your address for communication, telephone number, mobile number and email ID; your qualifications (degree or diploma, university or institution, main subjects, class, percentage of marks and year of passing), including M.Phil., Ph.D. and any other qualifications or certificates; whether you have cleared NET or GSET for Asst. Prof; your experience, starting with your current job (employer, designation, nature of responsibilities, period from and to, and gross salary). Under nature of responsibilities, mention any undergraduate or postgraduate teaching experience. Attach an extra sheet if you need more space.

content_sections.heading: About Gujarat University IIS
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Sustainability (IIS) is an institute of Gujarat University in Ahmedabad (380009). These posts are for its Integrated M.B.A. Programme.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 3 posts in total under Gujarat University IIS Recruitment 2026. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Shortlisting for the interview is based on the candidate's qualifications and research experience. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

Any Graduate from a recognized university
rows.experience_skills: Proficiency in Computer, Gujarati and English Typing; two-three years of relevant experience is desirable

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated amount per month: Rs. 40,000/- for the Research Fellow and Rs. 18,000/- for the Office Assistant. The notice does not mention any allowances. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a period of 6 months. The Research Fellow appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis for the defined period of the project. The selected candidate will not be entitled to claim a regular appointment or position in the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gujarat University IIS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit the online application form according to their preference of position. For the Non-Teaching Post, send applications by email to [email protected] . Applications are accepted from 27 October 2026 until 5:00 PM on 5 November 2026. More details are on the Gujarat University career page. The "Brief bio-data of candidate" form (Non-Teaching), printed with the notice. It asks for: the post applied for and your area of interest (subject); a photo; your full name, gender, date of birth and category (OPEN / SC / ST / SEBC / PH); your address for communication, telephone number, mobile number and email ID; your qualifications (degree or diploma, university or institution, main subjects, class, percentage of marks and year of passing), including M.Phil., Ph.D. and any other qualifications or certificates; whether you have cleared NET or GSET for Asst. Prof; your experience, starting with your current job (employer, designation, nature of responsibilities, period from and to, and gross salary). Under nature of responsibilities, mention any undergraduate or postgraduate teaching experience. Attach an extra sheet if you need more space. Self-attested copies of all documents. Your signature on the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only candidates found prima facie eligible will be called for an interview. Shortlisting for the interview is based on qualifications and research experience. The interview is scheduled for 17 November 2026. The notice does not mention the interview venue or the reporting time. Shortlisted candidates must attend the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA will be given.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Gujarat University IIS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Fellow and 2 Office Assistants. The University/School may increase or decrease the number of positions depending on its requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat University IIS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 5 November 2026, until 5:00 PM. Applications are accepted from 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: You need a Masters / Post Graduate / M.Sc. / Master Degree or equivalent degree with at least 55% marks or a CGPA of 5.5 in 10 points in scale. You also need 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: You must be a graduate from a recognized university. The notice also lists proficiency in Computer, Gujarati and English typing, and says two to three years of relevant experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Gujarat University IIS posts?
faq.answer: The Research Fellow gets a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. The Office Assistant gets a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Gujarat University IIS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the "Brief bio-data of candidate" form printed with the notice and attach self-attested copies of all documents. Email the application to [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process and when is the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications and research experience, and only those found prima facie eligible are called for an interview. The interview is scheduled for 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Gujarat University IIS job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual for 6 months. The Research Fellow post is temporary for the defined period of the project, and the selected candidate cannot claim a regular appointment in the institute.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. Shortlisted candidates must attend the interview at their own expense, and no TA/DA will be given.
